name: common-skills
description: BEYONDEE shared agent skills for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Permanent multi-repo worktrees, ready PRs and branch promotion.
interface.longDescription: BEYONDEE Skills bundles shared agent skills for Codex and Claude Code. It currently exposes multi-repo-worktree for explicitly invoked permanent development worktrees with one-time create, squash-merge-safe generation branches, isolated PR corrections, source-to-prod branch promotion, and help, status, submit, promote, pull, and sync workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use $common-skills:multi-repo-worktree status to inspect the current development bundle.
Use $common-skills:multi-repo-worktree submit to publish ready PRs while preserving local follow-up work.
Use $common-skills:multi-repo-worktree sync to bring development worktrees up to date with their source branches.
Use $common-skills:multi-repo-worktree promote to advance the configured source branches through dev, dev2, and prod.
